title: Can Claude Really Watch YouTube Videos?
description:
What if Claude could understand a 3-hour YouTube video without you watching the entire thing? 🤯
In this Short, discover how Claude Video works by combining video frames, transcripts, and timestamps to analyze long videos and answer questions about what happened inside them.
But can AI really understand video — or is it simply analyzing information?
Watch the full video on Tech Geek to see how this technology works and what it could mean for the future of AI.
